transcription: The Curiosity Club Episode 1 The Lunchbox Detective Here is something to listen for. What finally helped the children find the owners, the color or the labels? Ready? Let us find out. At Maple School, Maya puts a blue lunchbox on the table. Leo puts another blue lunchbox beside it. They look exactly the same. Is this yours? Maya asks. I think so.

The Curiosity Club Episode 2 Pip and the Upside-Down Library Here is something to listen for. Why was sorting only by color a problem? Ready? Let us find out. The school library needs help. Books are on tables, chairs, and even a windowsill. Pip is excited. I can sort them, he says. When Maya returns, every shelf looks beautiful. Ready?
